tools.name: list_workmap_tasks
tools.description: Read open WorkMap community tasks and work pools. Returns public instructions, submission links, and non-cash Harbor Points; it does not claim or submit work.

tools.name: get_cross_chain_report_quote
tools.description: Read the current price, supported networks, batch size, and payment destination for one cross-chain report. This tool never initiates a payment.

tools.name: submit_paid_cross_chain_report
tools.description: Redeem a report after the user has manually paid exactly 0.02 of a listed payment asset (USDC, USDT, or Binance-Peg BSC-USD) on its EVM network and manually signed the report authorization. This tool only submits the supplied receipt and signature for verification; it never pays, moves funds, approv

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_paid_cross_chain_report" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
